description: This Kotlin source file defines a lightweight SQLiteOpenHelper class called DatabaseHelper for managing recipes and categories in an Android app. It handles database creation, migration, and various CRUD operations for recipes and categories, including seeding initial data.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing local recipes and categories databases, including creation, upgrade, and data manipulation methods.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the recipes and categories tables and seeds initial data.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades by dropping existing tables and recreating them.

methods.name: insertRecipe
methods.description: Inserts a new recipe into the database.

methods.name: deleteRecipe
methods.description: Deletes a recipe by its ID.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Sets the favorite status of a recipe.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe entity by its ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all recipes ordered by title.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for recipes matching a query in title or description.

methods.name: favorites
methods.description: Retrieves all recipes marked as favorites.

methods.name: byCategory
methods.description: Retrieves recipes belonging to a specific category.

methods.name: categories
methods.description: Retrieves all category entities from the database.

methods.name: queryToList
methods.description: Helper method to perform SQL query and convert results to a list of RecipeEntity.

methods.name: mapRecipe
methods.description: Maps a database cursor row to a RecipeEntity object.
